configuration: trusted owner release injects shellOrigin and owner-only modules; no configuration from parent messages or URL
frame: direct child of the configured shell origin only; shell alone creates and navigates the frame

passkey.authority: owner passkey over the exact C5 challenge bytes only

phrase.identity_root: phrase-sealed random 32-byte secret; subject derives only from this secret
phrase.default_backup: v2; same credential PRF at original RP ID

approval.load: supervisor service by proposal id only
approval.display: injective rendering of the exact canonical C6 bytes
approval.authorization: supervisor supplies canonical C5 bytes; gate rebuilds and checks them

witness.schedule: each mount and each restored browser visit
witness.authority: none; alarms do not enable or disable owner actions
